dct_description_sm: A VCF file of a filtered SNP dataset including 5,525 unlinked SNPs from 599 sugar maple (Acer saccharum) individuals sampled across 52 sites in eastern North America. R scripts used for SNP filtering, phylogeographical analyses, palynological analyses, and ecological niche modeling.
dct_title_s: Data from: Postglacial migration lags behind climate suitability in a dominant eastern North American deciduous forest tree
